decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times 0900 to 1730 Monday to Friday and 0900 to 1300 on Saturdays and shall be closed on Sundays and bank holidays.

Condition : 5 - No development shall take place until a scheme to mitigate the impact of noise from the air handling unit has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The approved scheme shall be fully implemented in accordance with the approved details before the use commences and thereafter retained and maintained in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 6 - Use of the building as a Natwest Bank shall not commence place until all ducting and plant equipment relating to the previous A3 use of the building that is not required for the bank (A2) use hereby approved has been removed from the roof of the building (rear elevation).
description: Change of use from restaurant to a bank including new shop front and condensor to rear.
